summary.text: The first pregnancy of a non-consanguineous couple of Indian ethnicity was found at around 19 weeks of gestation to have multiple fetal anomalies. Antenatal ultrasound showed hyperextended knees, bilateral rocker bottom feet, flexed elbows and wrists, persistently clenched fists and generalized subcutaneous edema, with a 6 mm prominent nuchal fold and otherwise normal organ views. AMC was considered and the parents opted for medical termination of pregnancy.

The male fetus underwent postnatal autopsy, which showed generalized subcutaneous edema, a round face with micrognathia and other dysmorphic features, fixed elbow flexion, clenched hands, hyperextended knees and bilateral rocker bottom feet, with normal internal organs and no cleft lip/palate. Fetal radiographs showed no specific skeletal dysplasia.

Chromosomal microarray and the clinical exome panel for known AMC genes were negative. The fetus was hemizygous for a novel four-nucleotide deletion at the THOC2 intron 22 and exon 23 acceptor splice site, confirmed by Sanger sequencing, and the clinically normal mother was a carrier. The variant satisfied ACMG pathogenicity criteria and inheritance was X-linked recessive.

External examination and limited autopsy confirmed the findings of AMC, with dysmorphic facial features and generalized subcutaneous edema; these features pointed towards syndromic AMC. On follow-up, the family opted for in-vitro fertilization using an oocyte from an unrelated donor to avoid further recurrences.

article_limitations: Table 2 and the cohort statistics describe published THOC2 cases and are not attributed to the two fetuses.
Authors note lack of RNA or protein functional evidence for the variant effect (b00057); recorded only as an article limitation.

Variant-level statements (ACMG criteria, BLAST/VARSEEK analysis, inheritance) are recorded on both fetuses where the sentence covers the variant or "the fetuses"; the VARSEEK paragraph sits in the first-fetus work-up and is recorded on p1 only.
Medical termination of pregnancy is recorded as planned (parents opted); completion is not stated in words, although autopsy of the fetus is described.
Caption-layer figure status is not_inspected; pixels are described in visual.json.
Parental ethnicity and non-consanguinity are recorded only on p1 (first mention); the second pregnancy is of the same couple but its paragraph does not repeat them.
The follow-up IVF statement (b00008) concerns the family; it is recorded once on p2 with subject family_member (include) and as a planned event after the second-pregnancy recurrence.
